name_reason: Well-formed per the data convention: data_fd2_ (game global) + domain ui_anim + descriptor sprite_sheet + datatype suffix ptr. Accurately reflects use: a 32-bit pointer slot holding the malloc'd FDOTHER.DAT resource #5 buffer, which is the UI/menu/animation sprite sheet (dialog frame tiles + general UI sprites). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to 0x53A81). The '5' is the FDOTHER.DAT resource index used by the writer, not part of the symbol name.
purpose: Base pointer to the UI/menu animation sprite sheet, loaded as FDOTHER.DAT resource index 5; the source sheet for the resizable dialog/window frame (17 tiles) plus general menu/status/combat-overlay UI sprites.
logic_summary: BSS pointer slot, zero-initialized. Sole writer is main @ 0x25BF4: data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr = fd2_load_dat_resource(<FDOTHER.DAT name @ 0x51A4D>, prior_value, 5) -- the loader frees the prior buffer (NULL on first call), mallocs the resource size, and reads resource #5 from FDOTHER.DAT. The ~70 read sites pass this pointer as the sprite-sheet argument of blit helpers fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset / fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk. fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered composes a resizable dialog box from 17 tiles in this sheet (sprite idx 1-8 corners, 9-C/E/F edges, D center fill, 10/11 secondary corners); status/inventory panels, HP/phase banners, spell-projectile animations, shop and recruitment screens index further sprites out of the same sheet.
datatype: uint32 (32-bit address slot used as void*/sprite-sheet base pointer; Ghidra currently types the byte at 0x53A81 as undefined len=1, but every access is a 4-byte pointer load/store -- pointer semantics. This stage does not change the Ghidra datatype.)
element_semantics: Single 32-bit pointer value = base address of the malloc'd FDOTHER.DAT resource-5 buffer (the UI/animation sprite sheet). Not an array.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 5, uint32 BSS pointer slot) but terse relative to sibling DAT-pointer globals; it omitted the sole-writer load line, the engine-wide DAT-pointer convention cross-reference, and what the ~70 readers do with it (dialog-frame tiles + general UI sprites).
notes: Verified: path string at 0x51A4D = 'FDOTHER.DAT', at 0x51A43 = 'FDTXT.DAT'. fd2_load_dat_resource reads resource [index] from a packed DAT archive (offset-table header at index*4+6). Sibling resource pointers in the same main load block: idx0 all_game_text_ptr (FDTXT), idx1 runtime_battle_state_ptr, idx2 menu_dialog_state_handle, idx3 tile_anim_table_base, idx4 chinese_font_sheet, idx5 THIS (ui_anim_sprite_sheet), idx6 resource_portrait_sheet_ptr. Single WRITE xref (main @ 0x25CFA), all other ~70 xrefs are READ -> mutable runtime pointer, not const. Memory at 0x53A81 reads all-zero (BSS).
